overall: The AG found no violation: the same-day notice amendment adding a Zoom option did not violate the OML because the originally posted in-person location remained available.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board violated the OML by adding a Zoom link to the June 23 notice on meeting day, denying the public reasonable time to join.
allegations.key_passage: The addition of a Zoom access option, when the original posted access method continued to be available, did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
